title: Sword Art Online
native_title: ソードアート・オンライン
source: Sword Art Online light novels by Reki Kawahara (ongoing). Snapshots use the latest published arc.
world: In 2022, ten thousand players are trapped in the virtual reality MMO Sword Art Online, where dying in the game means dying for real. Solo player Kirito, the Black Swordsman, and Asuna of the Knights of the Blood Oath fight to clear the floating castle Aincrad and fall in love. Later arcs take them through other games (ALfheim Online, Gun Gale Online) and the Underworld simulation of Alicization. A blend of game adventure, romance and questions about AI.
power_system: Game systems: levels, skills and sword skills. Kirito has the Dual Blades skill. In the Underworld, imagination (Incarnation) can override the system.
